translation.en:
By the Grace of God, Friedrich Wilhelm, King of Prussia. Our Royal Grace, Friendship and good Will beforehand! Most Serene Prince, dearest Friend and dear Faithful One. Your Liebden receives herewith enclosed an engrossed copy of the purchase contract concluded with the Banco-Rendant Leixner over the estates Kolno and Kaemen, confirmed under this date. We remain well disposed toward you with Royal Grace, Friendship and favourable Will. Given at Posen, the 18th of March 1805. Royal South Prussian Government [illegible]raudchreig[illegible]

To

the reigning Lord

Fürst zu Hohenlohe

Ingelfingen, Liebden.

Fee 1 rt 2 g

Stamp 6 g

Mund[ierung, fair-copying]: 2 g

Ins[inuation, service]: 3 g

Your Liebden receives herewith enclosed an engrossed copy of the purchase contract concluded with the Banco-Rendant Leixner over the estates Kolno and Kaemen, confirmed under this date. We remain well disposed toward you with Royal Grace, Friendship and favourable Will. Given at Posen, the 18th of March 1805. Royal South Prussian Government [illegible]raudchreig[illegible]

To

the reigning Lord

Fürst zu Hohenlohe

Ingelfingen, Liebden.

Ins[inuation, service]: 3 g
summary_en: Royal rescript to the reigning Fürst zu Hohenlohe-Ingelfingen, transmitting an engrossed copy of the purchase contract concluded with the Banco-Rendant Leixner over the estates Kolno and Kaemen, confirmed under the same date, with the customary formulas of Royal grace and friendship. Issued by the Royal South Prussian Government at Posen over an illegible signature, and endorsed with the charges levied: fee 1 rt 2 g, stamp 6 g, fair-copying 2 g, service 3 g.
summary_de: Übersendung einer ausgefertigten Abfertigung des mit dem Banco-Rendanten Leixner geschlossenen und unter gleichem Datum königlich konfirmierten Kaufkontrakts über die Güter Kolno und Kaemen an den regierenden Fürsten zu Hohenlohe-Ingelfingen, mit den üblichen Gnaden- und Freundschaftsversicherungen Friedrich Wilhelms und der Unterschrift der Königlich Südpreußischen Regierung (Namenszug unleserlich). Am Fuß die Kostennotierung: Gebühr 1 rt 2 g, Stempel 6 g, Mundierung 2 g, Insinuation 3 g.
